# Spinner

That something is happening, when how long it will take is not known. Work whose extent is known belongs in a `ProgressBar`.

## Anatomy

A ring in the control colour with a leading arc in ink, rotating.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `number` | `20, label` | — |
| `label` *(required)* | `string` | — | Announced while the work is in progress. Required, so the wait is never silent. |

## Variants

None.

## States

Spinning; stilled under reduced motion, where the ring stays drawn and the label keeps announcing.

## Tokens consumed

| Token | Resolves to |
| --- | --- |
| `--border-control` | `#857c68 / #716b5c` |
| `--motion-pulse` | `1.8s` |
| `--text-primary` | `#1c1a16 / #ede6d6` |
| `--ui-border-emphasis` | `2px` |

Every value resolves through a semantic or component token; `scripts/check-fidelity.mjs` fails on a literal.

## Keyboard

Not interactive.

## ARIA

`role="status"` with a polite live region carrying the required `label`, so the wait is announced rather than only drawn.

## Accessibility acceptance criteria

- Reachable, operable and leavable by keyboard alone, with a focus indicator meeting 3:1 in both schemes.
- An accessible name for every control, and current state exposed programmatically.
- No meaning carried by colour alone.
- Legible and operable at a 360px viewport and at desktop width, and at 200% zoom.
- Interactive targets at least 44 × 44px on touch-capable viewports.
- Under reduced motion the ring stops rotating; the status region is what still reports the work.

## Reference correspondence

None. The reference has no loading indicator. The ring takes the control-contrast boundary its filled fields use, and the arc takes ink.

## Recorded deviations

None.
